ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   C. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   B. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
